title: SA/850/1976 of HARI PRASAD and ORS Vs SMT.  SATYAWATI  and ORS

paras.text:
SA No. 1219 of 2001
(Old No. 850/1976)
Hon'ble B.C. Kandpal, J.
(Misc. Application No. 11513 of 2006)
 This is an application filed by the
respondent stating therein that the present appeal
has been dismissed as abated. It has been averred
that during the pendency of the present appeal, the
appellant No. 1/2 has died and till date no
substitution application has been filed. Therefore,
for want of steps taken in this regard, the appeal
stands abated.
 In view of the aforesaid circumstance, the
appeal is dismissed being abated.
.
(B.C.K., J.)
12.09.2006
ASWAL
